Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning protection of health care information in the health benefit exchange related to navigators.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to ensuring that navigators associated with thehealth benefit exchange protect private health care information; andamending RCW 43.71.075.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.71.075 and 2012 c 87 s 25 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person or entity functioning as a navigator consistent withthe requirements of section 1311(i) of P.L. 111148 of 2010, asamended, shall not be considered soliciting or negotiating insurance asstated under chapter 48.17 RCW. (2) A person or entity functioning as a navigator may not requesthealth care information from any person seeking their services. Anyinformation inadvertently received by a navigator may not be disclosedto any third party and must be destroyed if in print or electronicform. If a person's health care information is received and disclosedto a third party in violation of this subsection, the navigator mustinform the person of the disclosure within five business days ofdiscovery of the disclosure. p. 1 SB 6354 (3) For the purposes of this section, "health care information" hasthe meaning provided in RCW 70.02.010.
